optimizer: AdamW, weight decay zero, constant learning rate
loss: English visible assistant answer including EOS only; non-thinking chat template
checkpoint: One-epoch low-dose exploratory follow-up; compare without checkpoint selection
broad_gate_note: Not rerun for this matched comparison dataset; this is not a transfer or evaluation result.
shuffle_rule: For epoch e, random.Random(seed + e).shuffle(list(range(n_examples))); identical row positions and seed in both arms.
source_presentation_rule: 32 distinct source IDs; H01 and H07 each appear three times (one shared v0 plus two additions); every other source appears once.
added_rows: Four matched slots after the shared 32-row base: audited H01/H07 v1/v2 candidates in arm A; exact H01/H07 v0 prompt/answer copies in arm B.
